searchDescription: Official website of Kiminou Knox, Bay Area raised author and poet of ten published books, host of KimYaps, Director at AAFC, and creator of the Black Boy Lie universe.
shortBio: Kiminou Knox is a Bay Area raised author and poet with ten published books. He writes across poetry, faith, identity, love, family, imagination, and youth storytelling, and is the creator of the Black Boy Lie universe. His essay was named the top essay at the Miles Hall Foundation's Breaking Barriers Youth Summit in February 2025.
catalogEditionNote: The official bibliography contains ten distinct published books: eight regular books and two cartoon books. Original and remastered formats are cataloged as editions of those books, not counted as additional titles.
